title: Where Ask, Plan, and Confirm are in the web workbench
summary: On the web workbench, switch Ask/Plan/Agent with the composer mode badge; Confirm is optional and Ask never clicks it for you.
narrative:
This card is only about the web workbench shell. It does not list CLI, TUI, or Notebook commands.

Mode switch: in the composer, click the mode badge that reads Ask ▾, Plan ▾, or Agent ▾. The menu lists three labels exactly: Ask, Plan, and Agent. Choose Plan when you want a reviewable plan artifact; choose Ask for handbook Q&A that does not execute.

Confirm: when a plan is ready, the chat shows a Plan ready card. The primary button is Confirm. Nearby actions are Change params, Cancel, and View Plan. Confirm is optional — you can keep typing instead of clicking it. Ask mode never clicks Confirm for you and never executes the plan.

What Ask and Plan mean as channels is a separate capability card. Do not treat a Python assistant.preview call as the only next step for finding these web buttons.
python_code:
from qteasy_ai.app import QteasyAssistant
assistant = QteasyAssistant()
print(assistant.ask('Plan 在哪', response_style='raw')['sources'])
risk_notes: Ask never confirms a plan. Web button labels are English: Ask, Plan, Agent, Confirm, View Plan.
